notes: Tuition: DAAD and the university's fee page give EUR 1,500 per semester for non-EU/non-EEA students (additional to the semester fee); the tuition amount is per semester, not per year. Intakes: deadlines 15 January / 15 July are stated on the programme page without a year and without saying they are specifically for international applicants; they are given here as recurring deadlines. ApplicationChannel: the pages do not state uni-assist or the university's own portal for international applicants (DAAD says only 'Please check this website'), so no applicationChannel fact is included. Documents: no document list for this programme's international applicants is quotable from the supplied pages, so no documents fact is included.
